experiment: Frozen-stage comparison on fresh development cases; no training or checkpoint selection.
findings: The final PPO hybrid deteriorated on four paired genuine-start development campaigns: mean last observed floor 1.25, versus 10.75 for imitation and 11.25 for the original combat hybrid. No controller won a campaign.

The largest teacher-agreement drop on the 256 identical combat states appeared between Overgrowth PPO and mixed PPO. No Overgrowth-PPO campaign arm was run, and region mixing is confounded with another 1024 collected decisions, optimizer updates and a new optimizer stage.

All 2048 PPO records have zero reward, advantage, return, value and next value. Reported policy and value losses are zero; 160 optimizer steps were driven by the entropy objective, without a sampled run-victory signal.
Fully learned transfer and imitation each hit the 1024-decision limit at floor zero in three of four cases, with repeated legal card selection/deselection instead of confirmation.

Transferred shared/actor tensors and original embeddings match exactly. New vocabulary embeddings change 16/320 choices, including 13/256 combat choices. Replacing only added rows with the source unknown embedding restores exact source probabilities on all 320 states.

reporting_corrections: Separate on-policy campaign evidence from common-state proxies; do not attribute deterioration causally to region mixing.
Keep critic objectives separate and do not infer absence of loops from public-state hashes.
verified: Paired seeds/regions and authoritative hybrid routing, public-only actor inputs and source/model bindings.
Distinct shadow identity, only added embedding rows changed, original candidate-reference joins and consistent denominators.
Independent four-rollout zero-signal and entropy-loss audit, frozen checkpoint lineage.
Published probe aggregates, exact shadow probability equality and selection-loop tails.

limitations: Four fresh development cases and one checkpoint lineage; no population strength claim.
Floor is the last public observed floor, not a win probability. HP in last_public_hud is pre-terminal.
Opportunity means energy>0 and at least one legal card play; it does not prove a card should be played.
Common-state panel follows the heuristic, not the learned actors; its agreement measures are diagnostic only.
Combat critic and run critic have different reward objectives; their magnitudes are not directly comparable.
Added-token shadow control isolates actor input changes on the fixed panel, not their causal campaign impact.
Prior-seed scan covered 84 ordinary headless replay audits, not every PPO replay audit.
The probe combat/other partition uses context labels, not the runner's authoritative nested combat ownership.
Public-decision hashes include history; unique hashes do not prove absence of a selection loop.
No production behavior changes or new training were made. The existing full Python suite was not rerun for this experiment and documentation update.
recommendations_not_implemented: First define and report handling for batches with zero advantages and zero value errors, preventing unobserved entropy-only drift while retaining canonical run-victory utility.
Improve selection-completion imitation on training cases, including actor-reached legal states, and check greedy rollout progress as well as teacher-state agreement.

Establish useful run-victory targets from explicitly labeled successful demonstrations or a bounded continuation curriculum, then repeat a fresh development comparison before increasing the multi-seed budget.
start: Genuine Ironclad A0 campaigns, all-seen/unlocked profile, paired engine seed and first-act region.

timings.notes: Investigation, experiment scripting, analysis, documentation and review overlapped; separate implementation duration was not measured. No user wait or release build was needed.

transfer_check.shadow_recipe: Only added vocabulary embeddings replaced with original combat unknown row; all other transfer tensors unchanged. Shadow inference only; not a deployable checkpoint.
